name: RAMEN-MISO
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Card title is RAMEN-MISO (Team RAMEN / team-suzuki, Matsuo Lab LLM competition 2025); the repo id keeps the SFT checkpoint name Qwen3-235B-A22B_SFT_004_origin_1. A CoT-SFT finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 235.094B parameters (94 layers, 128 experts, 8 active, kv heads 4 x head_dim 128 -> KV 192512 B/token = 94*4*128*2*2). flops_per_token_active = 2 * 22e9 = 4.4e10. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-08-21. The one winning row is a 120-question stratified subset of HLE (Extract120), and the card's own full-set HLE cell for this model is '??' - so the 19.33 is a subset number, not a full-HLE score. It also LOSES Do-Not-Answer 92.0 vs 97.9, recorded below rather than dropped.
